product_metadata.title: Cool White LED Frosted Tree – Alpine Tree – Lighted Tree Decor (6 Ft, 320 Lights)
features: 6-Foot Alpine tree decoration with frosted tips, lit by 320 cool white 5mm LED mini lights
Long 16-foot lead cord allows plenty of length for connecting to power
LED mini lights are up to 90% more energy efficient than incandescent lights, long-lasting, and always remain cool to the touch
UL listed; rated for indoor use
Downswept branches evoke conifers drooping under fresh snowfall. Ideal for creating winter holiday scenes in foyers, entryways, alcoves, bay windows and more.
description: These graceful lighted alpine trees make the perfect winter scene, either by themselves or in combination with other indoor Christmas decorations. Cool white 5mm LED mini lights provide brilliant light, with all the durability and energy-efficient of LED technology. And LED bulbs always remain cool to the touch. A long 16-foot lead allows for easy connection to power. Add a white base layer underneath these frosted trees to create a winter wonderland. Place some Christmas gift packages around them for a touch that is sure to please. These alpine trees from Wintergreen Lighting are perfect for foyers, entryways and alcoves.
